newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals steady on poor buying, low arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals steady on poor buying, low arrivals.

text.p: Base metals were steady at the improved level on local markets on Friday as industrial buying slowed on lower imports, dealers said.
"Industrial buying turned sluggish at the higher level but limited arrivals of imported metals kept market around previous level," said one dealer. "The market is consolidating gains."
Ready copper was steady at 13,150 rupees per quintal as was nickel at 37,200 rupees per quintal. On Thursday copper was up 50 rupees and nickel was up 200 rupees per quintal.

Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees per quintal as was zinc at 6,900 rupees and lead at 4,550 rupees amid nominal trading. Tin was available at the previous level of 34,400 rupees per quintal but volumes were low.
